sections.content: SubAndGain and Ufriends IT both promise cheap data and reliable VTU services in Nigeria, but they are built with different priorities. SubAndGain is a straightforward data and airtime platform, while Ufriends IT bundles VTU with NIN/BVN identity services. This article compares them honestly so you can decide which platform deserves your money.

We are not going to waste your time with fluff. This comparison covers real pricing differences, the services you actually get, how the platforms handle wallet funding, and what you are missing out on by choosing one over the other.

items.title: Data Pricing — Who Is Actually Cheaper?

sections.content: The Short Answer

SubAndGain is a solid platform for buying cheap data and airtime. If that is all you need, it works fine. But if you also need to print NIN slips, generate BVN slips, correct errors on your NIN or BVN, retrieve a lost BVN, or register a business with CAC, then Ufriends IT is the better option because it does everything SubAndGain does plus all of those extra services from one dashboard.
SubAndGain at a Glance

SubAndGain (subandgain.com) is a Nigerian VTU platform that provides data bundles for MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile, airtime recharge, cable TV subscriptions (DStv, GOtv, Startimes), electricity bill payments, and a few other digital services. The platform requires BVN or NIN verification for wallet funding through generated bank account details. SubAndGain has both a website and a mobile app available on iOS. Their pricing is structured to be affordable for both personal use and reselling.
Ufriends IT at a Glance

Ufriends IT (ufriends.com.ng) is a Nigerian platform that merges VTU services with government identity services. It handles data, airtime, cable TV, electricity, and exam pins like any VTU platform, but also offers NIN slip printing (Regular, Standard, Premium, VNIN), BVN slip generation, lawful NIN and BVN modification, BVN retrieval, and CAC business registration. Developers get access to API v1 with Sandbox Mode, Node.js and PHP SDKs, and webhooks. Wallet funding happens through dedicated virtual bank accounts with instant auto-credit.
Feature-by-Feature Comparison
Data Pricing — Who Is Actually Cheaper?

SubAndGain positions itself as an affordable data platform, and their rates are generally competitive. They offer SME data, corporate gifting bundles, and standard data plans for all four networks. Prices change frequently based on what the network providers charge.

Ufriends IT offers the same types of data bundles — SME, Corporate Gifting, Data Awoof, and standard plans — at competitive wholesale pricing. On a direct data-to-data comparison, prices are usually within a few naira of each other. Neither platform has a permanent pricing advantage because network providers adjust their backend rates often.

The real difference in value comes from what else you get. With Ufriends IT, the same wallet you use for data can also pay for NIN/BVN services. With SubAndGain, you need a separate platform (and separate wallet) for anything identity-related.
Identity Services — The Deal Breaker
This is where the two platforms diverge completely. SubAndGain does not offer any government or identity services. No NIN slip printing, no BVN retrieval, no name corrections, no CAC registration.

Ufriends IT provides a full suite of identity services: NIN slip printing in four different formats (from a basic table layout to a premium ID card design), BVN slip generation in regular and premium plastic formats, lawful NIN and BVN modification for correcting wrong names, dates of birth, and phone numbers, BVN retrieval using just your phone number, and CAC business name registration. If you have ever been turned away by a bank because your NIN details do not match your BVN, you will understand why having these services easily accessible is a game changer.
Wallet Funding and Payments

Both platforms use virtual bank accounts for wallet funding. SubAndGain requires you to update your account with your BVN or NIN to generate a unique bank account number. Ufriends IT also uses dedicated virtual bank accounts with instant auto-credit, meaning your wallet is funded the moment the transfer arrives. Both approaches work, but Ufriends IT's auto-credit tends to be faster and more seamless.
Developer API Comparison

SubAndGain provides API access for developers. Ufriends IT offers a more feature-rich API v1 with a Sandbox Mode for testing without spending real money, official SDKs for Node.js and PHP, and automated webhooks. If you are building an app that integrates VTU and identity verification, Ufriends IT's developer tools are more production-ready.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: Is SubAndGain a reliable VTU platform?
items.a: SubAndGain is generally reliable for data and airtime transactions. User reviews suggest it works well for daily purchases, though like any VTU platform, occasional delays can happen during peak network periods. Always test with small amounts first.

items.q: Can I print my NIN slip on SubAndGain?
items.a: No. SubAndGain does not offer NIN slip printing or any government identity services. For NIN slips, you would need to use a platform like Ufriends IT which supports Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN formats.

items.q: Which platform has cheaper MTN SME data?
items.a: Prices are very close. Both platforms offer wholesale-level MTN SME data rates that fluctuate based on network pricing. Check both dashboards for current rates before buying in bulk.

items.q: Can I correct my BVN name on SubAndGain?
items.a: No. BVN modification services are not available on SubAndGain. Ufriends IT offers lawful BVN modification for name, date of birth, and phone number corrections directly from the dashboard.

items.q: Does SubAndGain have an API for developers?
items.a: Yes, SubAndGain provides API access. However, Ufriends IT's API is more feature-rich with Sandbox Mode, official SDKs, and webhook support, making it better suited for production applications.

items.q: Do I need BVN to use SubAndGain?
items.a: SubAndGain requires BVN or NIN to generate your virtual bank account details for wallet funding. Ufriends IT also requires identity verification for virtual account generation, which is standard regulatory practice in Nigeria.
